title: Enforce ownership of every Cashflow and Minor subresource
body:
- Cashflow authentication checks module access, not record ownership: [auth](../backend/src/context.ts:47). Invoice get/update/delete/paid/send handlers omit userId entirely: [routes](../backend/src/routes/cashflow.ts:73); service reads by ID only [service](../backend/src/modules/cashflow/cashflow-invoices.ts:74). Minor criteria, feedback and reflection do likewise [routes](../backend/src/routes/minor.ts:92), [criteria](../backend/src/modules/minor/minor-stories.ts:429), [feedback](../backend/src/modules/minor/minor-evaluations.ts:141).
- Impact: a signed-in module user who obtains another record ID can reach code paths that read/change another user's records; list isolation alone does not protect records. No exploit attempted.
- Recommended option A: require userId in service signatures and join child records through their owner; validate all referenced client/project/trade-name IDs on create/update. Option B: central authorization repository/helpers with the same guarantees; less duplication, larger refactor.
- Acceptance: isolated two-user tests deny GET, update, delete, email, paid status, criterion, feedback and reflection access across users; legitimate owner flows pass. Cross-owner relationship assignment rejected. UI treats forbidden as access denied and retains drafts.

title: Recipe fields cannot actually be cleared
body: Clear an existing description, kitchen or cooking time, save, and the old value is retained: the form sends `undefined`, and update uses nullish fallback to existing values. No runtime reproduction performed. [form:134](../../frontend/src/components/recipe-form.tsx#L134), [service:188](../../backend/src/modules/recipes/index.ts#L188). Minimal/recommended: explicit nullable patch fields, with omitted meaning unchanged and null meaning clear. Broader option: shared validated edit schema and dirty-field patches. Acceptance: clear each optional field, reload, see blank; untouched fields remain unchanged. Recipe rating only offers 1–10 and no clear control despite backend accepting 0–10; include explicit Unrated and 0 if the product promises 0–10 [detail:175](../../frontend/src/components/recipe-detail.tsx#L175), [service:251](../../backend/src/modules/recipes/index.ts#L251).

title: Failed recipe saves can partially change the recipe
body: Create inserts the parent before checking ingredient quantity; update writes parent and deletes existing ingredients before checking replacement quantities. Neither service nor direct route caller wraps these operations in a transaction. A malformed API payload or insertion failure can leave partial data while UI says save failed. This is especially relevant to future import features, even though the present form checks positive quantities. [service:113–234](../../backend/src/modules/recipes/index.ts#L113), [routes:39–40](../../backend/src/routes/recipes.ts#L39). Recommended: validate the complete input before writes and transactionally replace related rows. Broader: shared request schemas, structured field errors, transactional service boundary. Acceptance: an invalid second ingredient or injected failure leaves all prior fields, steps and ingredients unchanged; invalid create leaves no recipe row. Invalid rating/status should be a proper 4xx, not a returned Error object [service:245](../../backend/src/modules/recipes/index.ts#L245).

title: Quick actions need visible saving/error states
body: Recipe status/rating/delete await calls without catch or pending state; delete dialog closes before the request. Wine delete catches only to console and dismisses confirmation. On a timeout or access expiry the user lacks a clear explanation or retry. [recipe detail:54–68,150](../../frontend/src/components/recipe-detail.tsx#L54), [wine card:65](../../frontend/src/app/recipes/wines/wine-card.tsx#L65). Recommended: one pending action, inline error and retry, keep destructive dialog open until confirmed success. Broader: consistent mutation-feedback primitive with optimistic rollback for reversible rating/status changes. Acceptance: simulated 403/500/offline yields readable localized error, preserves current value, and prevents double submission. No need for global toast spam on every successful click.

title: Body chart turns missing muscle values into zero and compresses irregular time
body: Mass tab includes logs with either muscle or fat mass; missing muscle is then plotted as zero. Every row gets equal x spacing regardless of dates. A fat-only entry can appear as a sudden muscle collapse; one day and one month appear equally far apart. [chart:7–15,41–74](../../frontend/src/app/workouts/body/body-chart.tsx#L41). Recommended: independent nullable series, real elapsed-time x scale, no fabricated zero, labels explain gaps. Broader: date-range controls, optional clearly labelled trend smoothing, table alternative. Acceptance: synthetic Jan 1/2/31 records have proportional spacing; fat-only entries never imply muscle=0; a one-point series is understandable. Tooltips are hover-only SVG groups with no keyboard target [chart:96–145](../../frontend/src/app/workouts/body/body-chart.tsx#L96): provide keyboard/touch details and accessible data summary.

title: Offline workout acknowledgement can clear newer local work
body: `syncOfflineSession` reads a snapshot, awaits server writes, then clears the storage key unconditionally, without checking `updatedAt` against newer edits. Global 15s sync and session sync coexist. Title save also clears the whole session snapshot after a title-only request, outside the exercise promise queue. The exercise queue's local version check is a good safeguard, but does not encompass these other paths. [offline:307–337,367 onward](../../frontend/src/lib/offline-workout.ts#L307), [session sync:60–97,148–166](../../frontend/src/components/use-session-sync.ts#L60). Recommended: one per-session sync coordinator and compare revision before acknowledging/deleting cache; serialize title/pause/exercise/complete through it. Broader: server revision/conflict detection for multi-device edits. Acceptance: delay snapshot A response, write local B, then resolve A; B remains pending and ultimately reaches server. Repeat across title change, pause, finish, background timer and two tabs.

title: 'Saved locally' must mean durable storage succeeded
body: `saveOfflineSession` returns void and swallows storage failure with console logging. Finish path unconditionally offers savedLocally after network failure, so quota/security errors could produce an inaccurate promise. [offline:138–159](../../frontend/src/lib/offline-workout.ts#L138), [finish:257–286](../../frontend/src/components/use-session-finish.ts#L257). Recommended: return verified persistence result and show blocking 'not saved' recovery with copy/export current workout, retaining in-memory state. Broader: IndexedDB transactional queue (still handle write failure). Acceptance: forced storage exception plus network outage must never display saved locally; recovery export preserves all sets. Existing rejected-sync UI is valuable and should remain [provider:51–119](../../frontend/src/components/offline-sync-provider.tsx#L51).

title: Make Wines' sharing/permission model explicit before expanding it
body: Wines store userId but `list(_userId)` ignores it and get/update/delete only use wineId. All wine routes use recipeAuth (`recipes` permission), not a wine permission. Recipes are global too. This might be an intentional household collection, so it is not automatically a security defect; users need an explicit shared-library model if it is intentional. [wine service:21,59,112,154](../../backend/src/modules/wines/index.ts#L21), [routes:50–81](../../backend/src/routes/recipes.ts#L50), [context:83](../../backend/src/context.ts#L83), [schema:5](../../backend/src/db/schema/wines.ts#L5). Option A: preserve shared collection, label it and define contributor/editor rights. Option B: private-by-default user ownership enforced on every list/read/mutation plus explicit sharing (more migration work). Acceptance: a two-user permission matrix has deliberate outcomes for read/edit/delete and UI communicates them. Root agent should combine with its broader authorization audit.

title: Search must match the user's current module
body: On Pulse, Cashflow, Minor, Resume or Minecraft, opening header search and entering a term calls recipe suggestions and submitting goes to `/recipes`. Only workouts have a separate path. This is a concrete surprising navigation behavior, not a proposed missing feature. [Search routing](../frontend/src/components/search-bar.tsx:32), [submission](../frontend/src/components/search-bar.tsx:131), [always mounted](../frontend/src/components/nav-header.tsx:163). Recommended option: module-scoped search with visible scope and clear results/empty/error states; hide it in modules without meaningful search. Alternative: explicit cross-module command palette, permission-filtered results and keyboard shortcut. Also cancel/ignore stale suggestion requests (current debounce cancels timers only). Acceptance: search from every module stays in declared scope; no forbidden-module requests; slower old response cannot replace new query results; screen reader gets combobox/listbox/active-option semantics.
options: Remove misleading fallback; scope or hide search (recommended)

title: Account menu needs a complete keyboard/mobile contract
body: The trigger advertises a menu, but rendered popup is a generic div; no Escape handler, arrow navigation, focus transfer/return. On narrow screens its only text is CSS-hidden and icons have no explicit accessible trigger label. Clicking outside closes it; keyboard behavior lacks parity. [Menu](../frontend/src/components/nav-header.tsx:165), [outside handler](../frontend/src/components/nav-header.tsx:52). W3C menu-button pattern expects menu semantics and focus into first item on activation. [W3C](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/menu-button/). Recommended: existing accessible menu primitive. Alternative: simple disclosure with ordinary links/buttons and appropriate disclosure semantics, no menu promise. Acceptance: named trigger at 320px; Tab/Enter/Escape functional; predictable focus return; no keyboard trap.

title: Authentication should resume the task and explain recovery
body: Runtime-verified: unauthenticated navigation to `/recipes?q=synthetic-audit` redirected to bare `/`, losing destination/query. Source: local login always goes to dashboard; proxy Cloudflare exchange preserves pathname only; central API throws raw error but has no shared 401 recovery; server current-user fetch maps every exception including outage to null. Production hides logout entirely. Cloudflare exchange treats every 403 (including account paused) as 'Geen account gevonden'. [Proxy](../frontend/src/proxy.ts:5), [login](../frontend/src/components/login-form.tsx:25), [API](../frontend/src/lib/api/core.ts:23), [server identity](../frontend/src/lib/server-api.ts:36), [production logout](../frontend/src/components/nav-header.tsx:208), [CF denial](../frontend/src/app/api/auth/cf-exchange/route.ts:35). Recommended: typed auth/offline/permission states, safe same-origin returnTo including query, preserve drafts before reauthentication, explicit Cloudflare-aware sign-out/account switching. Alternative: central session-expired dialog that resumes the current action after login. Acceptance: expiry during form entry loses no draft; outage shows retry rather than credential error; paused/no-account distinct; successful reauth restores route+filters; test actual Cloudflare production flow separately. Do not infer frontend proxy omission is an authorization bypass: backend guards exist.

title: Session expiry compares incompatible timestamp formats
body: Backend stores ISO timestamps with `T` but compares text to SQLite `CURRENT_TIMESTAMP` with a space. [creation/comparison](../backend/src/auth/index.ts:49). Verified separately using in-memory SQLite literals: `'2026-10-19T08:00:00.000Z' > '2026-10-19 18:00:00'` returns 1, while comparing their julianday values returns 0. Server-side validation can accept a timestamp already expired earlier that UTC day; normal browser cookie expiry limits the visible effect but does not repair server validation. Recommended: compare same ISO-format UTC value or numeric epoch consistently across all session methods. Alternative: migrate to numeric epoch with non-destructive migration. Acceptance: at exact expiry invalid, just before valid, around UTC midnight consistent; existing records remain usable until their real expiry; no live DB modification for verification.

title: Protect the last administrator and make permission changes atomic
body: A Pulse user can click Pause on self (only impersonation hides for self) or remove own Pulse permission; backend receives target ID and applies directly, with no last-active-admin invariant. Permission replacement deletes rows then inserts without a transaction. [self actions](../frontend/src/app/pulse/user-row.tsx:229), [route](../backend/src/routes/pulse.ts:50), [service](../backend/src/modules/pulse/index.ts:106). Scenario: sole administrator pauses self or removes Pulse, loses admin UI and needs CLI recovery; insertion failure can leave partially removed permissions. Recommended: enforce at least one active Pulse administrator server-side, transactional update and explicit consequence confirmation; retain CLI break-glass recovery. Alternative: forbid self-revocation/pause entirely. Acceptance: direct API as well as UI blocks final-admin removal; second admin can change first; failures rollback full permission set; clear actionable errors. Also use per-user pending state rather than one global loadingUserId for overlapping row operations (client.tsx:49,99–154).

title: Honor Minecraft read boundaries, not just write boundaries
body: Middleware checks assigned slug for `/servers/:slug`, then returns immediately for any GET. Therefore monitor-role users can reach unscoped GET `/import/scan`, `/templates`, template metadata and template file lists, though writes require full access. [route guard](../backend/src/routes/minecraft.ts:8), [template endpoints](../backend/src/routes/minecraft.ts:163). This is a verified policy inconsistency; the sensitivity of returned metadata depends on deployment. Recommended: explicit capability matrix, default-deny admin reads, server-specific scopes; return UI capabilities from backend. Alternative: simpler monitor vs operator vs administrator roles. Acceptance: assigned monitor sees only intended server resources, cannot enumerate imports/global templates; UI and direct API agree; unauthorized and nonexistent states do not conflate. Pterodactyl documents separate console, power, file, backup and schedule capabilities rather than one global full-access toggle. [Pterodactyl permissions](https://docs.pterodactyl.io/v1/api/client-general/get-show-permissions).

title: Show stale/disconnected status instead of false certainty
body: Minecraft defaults status to offline, ignores polling failures, turns initial request errors into Not Found, and file-list failures into empty arrays. Polls run every 5s with no in-flight overlap guard. [status/poll](../frontend/src/app/games/minecraft/[slug]/page.tsx:32), [failure](../frontend/src/app/games/minecraft/[slug]/page.tsx:97), [file list](../frontend/src/app/games/minecraft/[slug]/files/page.tsx:50). Scenario: tunnel drops while server was online; screen retains online indefinitely, or new page says missing/empty, encouraging wrong actions. Recommended: last-success timestamp, stale badge, retry, distinguish 401/403/404/network, non-overlapping polling with backoff and hidden-tab pause. Alternative: SSE/WebSocket with fallback polling; more effort, not prerequisite. Acceptance: network cut shows unknown/stale within bounded interval; never represents failed file fetch as genuinely empty; retry restores state without full reload; only one poll in flight.

title: Server stop/restart needs consequence preview and durable phases
body: Stop/restart buttons dispatch immediately. Backend graceful stop escalates after 20s to TERM then KILL; UI communicates only a spinner, and backend returns ok even after forced path. [buttons](../frontend/src/app/games/minecraft/[slug]/page.tsx:285), [action handler](../frontend/src/app/games/minecraft/[slug]/page.tsx:141), [backend](../backend/src/modules/minecraft/lifecycle.ts:146). Scenario: restart with players connected interrupts session; slow world save becomes force termination without the operator being informed. Recommended: confirm showing server/player count, announce/countdown option, job states saving/stopping/starting/ready/failed and report graceful vs forced outcome. Alternative: explicit separate force-stop requiring stronger confirmation; preserve configurable automated escalation for unattended policy. Acceptance: duplicate clicks do not create duplicate operations; reconnect recovers job; no 'ready' until readiness probe succeeds; UI warns if forced termination occurred.

title: Make failures visible and recoverable
body:
- New invoice initialization and inline client creation swallow all errors [form](../frontend/src/app/cashflow/invoices/new/new-invoice-form.tsx:123) and [client creation](../frontend/src/app/cashflow/invoices/new/new-invoice-form.tsx:209). Detail load redirects away on every error, including transient network failures [detail](../frontend/src/app/cashflow/invoices/[id]/page.tsx:37). Minor story save/upload/toggle errors go only to console [hook](../frontend/src/app/minor/sprints/[id]/use-story-editor.ts:134).
- Impact: a button appears to do nothing; failed invoice initialization looks like empty client/project lists. A user may create duplicates or abandon work.
- A recommended: inline Dutch error near operation, persistent recovery action, explicit loading/empty/error states; preserve values. B: shared toast plus inline validation (faster breadth, toast alone insufficient for long forms).
- Acceptance: simulated 401, 403, 500 and offline responses have distinct actionable states; retry works without retyping; assistive tech announces failures; transient invoice detail failure stays on detail route.

title: Preserve invoice drafts and stop defaults overwriting user choices
body:
- New invoice fields exist in React state [form](../frontend/src/app/cashflow/invoices/new/new-invoice-form.tsx:35); client selection unconditionally changes first line price [rate](../frontend/src/app/cashflow/invoices/new/new-invoice-form.tsx:70); invoice date edit unconditionally resets due date to +14 days [date](../frontend/src/app/cashflow/invoices/new/new-invoice-form.tsx:171). No draft persistence/beforeunload found in these module directories.
- Scenario: enter custom rate and payment terms, change client/date, discover manual values silently changed; navigate away and lose unsaved form.
- A recommended: user-scoped local draft, restore/discard, dirty flags so defaults apply only to untouched fields; clear draft on successful save/logout. B: server draft autosave (cross-device, more API/cleanup work). Small option: navigation warning plus explicit “Apply client rate” action.
- Acceptance: interrupted 10-line invoice restores correctly; intentional rate/due-date edits survive client/date changes; explicit reset to defaults available; no cross-user draft exposure.

title: Define invoice lifecycle, send history and reminders
body:
- Email method sends attachment and returns success without changing invoice status or persisting sentAt [send](../backend/src/modules/cashflow/cashflow-invoices.ts:334). Status list filtering happens on stored status before overdue status is computed [list](../backend/src/modules/cashflow/cashflow-invoices.ts:28), so querying overdue need not include stored-sent invoices whose due date has passed.
- Impact: successfully emailed draft can still appear as draft; displayed overdue badges and filtered results may disagree. Recipient retries have no durable history visible here.
- A recommended: explicit Draft → Sent → Paid transition, timestamped send attempts, canonical derived overdue predicate shared by counts/filters. Add manual reminder queue next. B: outbox plus recurring invoice/reminder scheduler for heavier use; requires delivery/idempotency handling. External invoicing integration is another option if automation demand outgrows this module.
- Acceptance: successful send records attempt and moves draft to sent; failed send retains draft with retry; duplicate retry cannot silently double-send; overdue counts/filter/detail agree; user controls reminder recipients and schedule.

title: Save invoices atomically and calculate authoritative totals
body:
- Create inserts parent then lines outside transaction [create](../backend/src/modules/cashflow/cashflow-invoices.ts:180). Update writes parent, deletes all existing lines, then reinserts [update](../backend/src/modules/cashflow/cashflow-invoices.ts:285). totalCost is trusted from body [line](../backend/src/modules/cashflow/cashflow-invoices.ts:308); routes cast unvalidated body as any [route](../backend/src/routes/cashflow.ts:72).
- Impact: later insert failure can leave a partial invoice even after UI reports save failure. Quantity/rate/discount and total can disagree through direct API requests or future UI defects.
- A recommended: runtime input schema + server total calculation with explicit rounding rules + transaction encompassing header/lines. B: shared calculation package consumed on both sides, server still authoritative; larger maintenance investment.
- Acceptance: malformed later line rolls back entire update; total equals agreed formula; nonfinite values/unknown types rejected; discount/credit conventions documented and tested. This is an engineering integrity finding, not tax/compliance advice.

title: Prevent unrelated Minor saves from erasing drafts
body:
- reloadSprint replaces self-evaluations/teacher assessments by default and always replaces reflection fields [reload](../frontend/src/app/minor/sprints/[id]/use-sprint-data.ts:31). Feedback add/delete invokes it [feedback](../frontend/src/app/minor/sprints/[id]/use-sprint-data.ts:51), as does saving a story [story](../frontend/src/app/minor/sprints/[id]/use-story-editor.ts:129).
- Scenario: type reflection or assessment, switch to feedback, add feedback, return: server snapshot overwrites the unsaved text. Hook retains form state across tabs, making this an especially surprising interaction.
- A recommended: separate server snapshot from dirty field drafts; merge only untouched fields after background reload. B: independent section autosave with version checking and explicit status; more seamless but more synchronization work.
- Acceptance: edits in every tab survive unrelated save/delete/reload; save failure leaves draft intact; conflicts are surfaced; explicit discard restores latest server state.

title: Separate saving Minor work from public publishing
body:
- Saving self-evaluations notifies publication [save](../backend/src/modules/minor/minor-evaluations.ts:108); reflection save ALSO notifies [reflection](../backend/src/modules/minor/minor-evaluations.ts:184), despite module guide describing only self-evaluation trigger. Webhook uses 3-second fire-and-forget request and console warning only [notifier](../backend/src/modules/minor/publish-notifier.ts:9). UI module search found no public publishing terminology. Configuration restricts publication to the designated user.
- Impact: “saved” does not tell the author whether content was made public or whether public site is stale; evaluations and assessments are sequential separate saves, so snapshot timing can observe partial update [UI save](../frontend/src/app/minor/sprints/[id]/use-sprint-data.ts:161).
- A recommended: explicit Publish action, snapshot preview, last successful publication, pending/error indicator; publish transactionally consistent snapshot. B: retain auto-publish but clearly label save action and show sync status/retry, with draft opt-out.
- Acceptance: author can identify exactly what is public; webhook failures do not masquerade as successful publish; later teacher/other edits trigger consistent refresh or visible unpublished-change state. Preserve existing snapshot contract/n8n integration; do not modify external site without separate approval.

title: Make Resume autosave reliable before navigation
body:
- Debounced effect waits 600ms and clears timer on cleanup [autosave](../frontend/src/app/resume/[id]/client.tsx:77); settings and selected items are separate sequential writes, no flush/revision/serialization in this effect. Export uses current local state [export](../frontend/src/app/resume/[id]/client.tsx:182).
- Scenario: change and immediately leave; pending timer cancels and update is unsaved. Overlapping requests may finish out of order; PDF can contain unsaved state while subsequent reopen differs.
- A recommended: serialized autosave queue, single atomic versioned editor endpoint, visible saved/saving/offline/retry status, local recovery and navigation flush/guard. B: explicit Save button plus dirty guard (simpler, less fluid).
- Acceptance: navigate within 600ms and return without losing work; artificial slow/out-of-order requests cannot revert latest edit; failed item save cannot claim entire CV saved; downloadable draft is explicitly distinguished when persistence failed.

title: Restore keyboard reordering and usable touch targets
body:
- Resume reorder arrows are hidden at lg breakpoint; grip is a nonfocusable separator with only pointer handlers [controls](../frontend/src/app/resume/[id]/client.tsx:253). Therefore desktop keyboard users lose reorder controls. Cashflow invoice delete is a 14px icon + 12px padding (about 28px including border), below repository 44px target [delete](../frontend/src/app/cashflow/invoices/[id]/page.tsx:147); paid-date has no explicit accessible label [date](../frontend/src/app/cashflow/invoices/[id]/page.tsx:120).
- A recommended: retain up/down buttons at all widths, descriptive per-item labels, announce position changes, 44px targets and explicit input labels. B: implement full keyboard drag interaction (space/arrow/escape), but arrows are lower-risk and more discoverable.
- Acceptance: keyboard-only user reorders at 1440px viewport; screen reader hears item and new position; mobile delete/date/edit controls meet 44px project convention without overlap.

title: Measurement editing can silently switch or replace the user's draft
body: Editing another row directly replaces shared form state; New while editing also replaces it. During creation, changing date to one with an existing log silently populates its values while editingId stays 0; save is a backend upsert. This may be convenient, but the interface should tell users whether they are creating or updating. [body page:115–151](../../frontend/src/app/workouts/body/page.tsx#L115), [measurement service:146–177](../../backend/src/modules/measurements/index.ts#L146). Recommended: label 'Edit existing measurement for this date', protect dirty form before switching rows/dates. Alternative: strict create with collision link to edit; more predictable, one extra step. Acceptance: changing to an existing date announces edit mode; switching away from unsaved input offers keep/discard, and collision cannot quietly overwrite another day's values.

title: Photo removal is immediate and permanent
body: Small thumbnail X calls delete directly without confirmation/undo; backend deletes record then physical file. Full measurement deletion correctly has confirmation, so photo behavior is inconsistent. [body card:165](../../frontend/src/app/workouts/body/body-log-card.tsx#L165), [upload hook:65](../../frontend/src/app/workouts/body/use-photo-upload.ts#L65), [measurement service:267 onward](../../backend/src/modules/measurements/index.ts#L267), [body page:385](../../frontend/src/app/workouts/body/page.tsx#L385). Minimal: preview plus confirmation; broader: delayed deletion with Undo and server retention policy (requires migration/storage policy). Acceptance: accidental removal can be cancelled or undone; failed delete leaves thumbnail and an actionable message. Avoid physical removal before undo window expires.

title: Apply accessibility fixes to the actual dense controls
body: Recipe rating controls are 32px, wine edit/delete 32px; these miss repo's 44px tap target requirement. Recipe selected state is only visual (no radio/pressed semantics). Measurement labels are siblings without `htmlFor` or matching ids; chart values are hover-only. [recipe detail:175–211](../../frontend/src/components/recipe-detail.tsx#L175), [wine card:94,131](../../frontend/src/app/recipes/wines/wine-card.tsx#L94), [body edit:62–86,122](../../frontend/src/app/workouts/body/body-edit-card.tsx#L62). Recommended: 44px hit areas, proper radio group or aria-pressed, associated labels and persistent units, keyboard/touch chart access. Alternative: compact desktop visuals with larger invisible hit regions where spacing permits. Acceptance: keyboard-only completion and screen-reader announced label/unit/current rating; 320px layout without horizontal overflow. Don't claim a full WCAG certification from this review.
options: Compact visuals with expanded hit regions

title: Add a focused cooking mode
body: Current recipe detail renders a static ingredient table and numbered paragraphs [detail:218–292](../../frontend/src/components/recipe-detail.tsx#L218). Paprika documents ingredient crossing-off, highlighted current step, keep-screen-on, timers and scaling [official Paprika](https://www.paprikaapp.com/), checked 2026-10-19. Recommended small version: checklist ingredients, highlight step, reset progress, optional wake lock. Broader version: base servings plus portion scaling and multiple timers; requires explicit unit/scaling rules and schema migration. Acceptance: cook hands-busy on mobile, resume current step, never mutate base ingredient amounts when scaling. Save progress per recipe locally and communicate device-only state. Defer meal planning until cooking flow works.

title: Improve measurement interpretation without creating a medical product
body: Current chart has four metric tabs and no date-range selector [body page:333–358](../../frontend/src/app/workouts/body/page.tsx#L333). Withings official search result describes a moving-average weight trend [official support](https://support.withings.com/hc/en-us/articles/202720528-How-can-I-see-my-weight-fat-mass-and-BMI-on-the-Health-Mate-app-); full-page fetch failed, so treat this comparator as lower-confidence than the others. Option A/recommended: period selection, latest/change summary, raw points with accurate dates and missing-value behavior (D04 first). Option B: optional labelled smoothed trend and side-by-side photo comparison. Acceptance: users can distinguish a raw record from a trend; sparse data shows insufficient data rather than a misleading trend. Do not copy health scoring or prescriptive targets.

title: Touch sizing contradicts the design contract
body: Base button sizes are 24–36px high, search trigger 36px and login controls 40px. There is no coarse-pointer size override in the inspected stylesheet. These violate DESIGN.md's own 44×44 mobile rule; do not call every one an automatic WCAG AA violation, since AA target-size exceptions/spacing differ. [Button variants](../frontend/src/components/ui/button.tsx:22), [search](../frontend/src/components/search-bar.tsx:223), [login](../frontend/src/components/login-form.tsx:47), [design](../DESIGN.md). Recommended: 44px hit regions on coarse pointers/mobile while retaining compact visual density on desktop. Alternative: user-selectable compact/comfortable density with mobile minimum enforced. Acceptance: inspect actual bounding boxes at 320/375/768px, adjacent targets do not overlap, keyboard focus remains visible. Login visual inspected at desktop; mobile geometry not runtime-tested.

title: Pulse updates/reboots need history and reconnect outcome
body: Update UI polls only while status running and silently swallows errors. Reboot stores local `rebootRequested` flag, without a reconnection state machine. Service holds current update state in process memory (class, inspect alongside source), so durable historical evidence is absent from this flow. [polling](../frontend/src/app/pulse/system-panel.tsx:74), [reboot](../frontend/src/app/pulse/system-panel.tsx:177), [service](../backend/src/modules/pulse/system-update-service.ts:119). Recommended: durable operation ID/history, last status timestamp, expected disconnect notice, health polling/backoff, final verification after return. Alternative: keep Pulse lightweight and deep-link to Cockpit for OS maintenance. Cockpit source shows update history, success state and reboot/service-restart choices. [Cockpit update implementation](https://github.com/cockpit-project/cockpit/blob/main/pkg/packagekit/updates.jsx). Acceptance: reload mid-operation reconnects to same job, backend restart doesn't erase last result, timeout has a recovery action, no success claim merely because reboot request was accepted.

title: Preserve actionable errors until resolved
body: Pulse dismisses success and error messages alike after 3s, while mutations use generic failure text. Minecraft uses native alert/prompt/confirm for several actions. [Pulse notifications](../frontend/src/app/pulse/client.tsx:58), [Minecraft actions](../frontend/src/app/games/minecraft/[slug]/page.tsx:141). Recommended: shared inline errors bound to affected control plus optional notification, persistent until dismissed/retried; distinguish validation, permission, session, connectivity and server failure with user action. Alternative: persistent notification center for admin jobs, inline errors for forms. Acceptance: error remains readable after 10s; retry preserves input; correct live-region announcement; keyboard focus restored after dialogs. Avoid confirmations for every reversible action: reserve for consequence-changing operations.

title: Add verified backup/restore workflow before more server features
body: Reviewed Minecraft routes expose lifecycle/files/templates/import/player operations but no backup/restore endpoint; searching module/frontend for backup returned no matches. Templates are not a verified recovery workflow. [Minecraft routes](../backend/src/routes/minecraft.ts:4). This is a scoped feature-gap finding, not proof no external backup system exists. Recommended: on-demand and scheduled world backup with last-success age, retention and tested restore; dry-run metadata and restore to new instance first. Alternative: integrate existing external backup system and surface status/recovery instructions; do not duplicate infrastructure unnecessarily. Pterodactyl explicitly models backup create/read/delete/download and server schedules. [Pterodactyl permissions](https://docs.pterodactyl.io/v1/api/client-general/get-show-permissions). Acceptance: a synthetic world restores to a separate instance, backup failures surfaced, operators see restore consequences and available recovery points, no overwrite without confirmation.

title: Make portfolio export readiness consistent and observable
body:
- Bulk PDF exports without the preflight that Excel runs [PDF/Excel](../frontend/src/app/minor/export/client.tsx:77). JSON export also lacks it, which is acceptable for raw backup, but purpose should be clear. Sprints fetch sequentially [fetch](../frontend/src/app/minor/export/client.tsx:68); export failures only log to console.
- A recommended: common readiness summary for submission-oriented PDF/Excel, links directly to missing fields, optional clearly marked incomplete export; keep JSON backup permissive. Show progress and retry failed download. B: asynchronous export job for large portfolios; more infrastructure, unnecessary until real scale demands it.
- Acceptance: identical incomplete sprint produces matching readiness advice in PDF/Excel; backup remains available; export cancellation/retry does not clear selection; failure visible; bounded parallel fetch avoids linear latency.

title: Offer archive/restore and impact previews for deletion
body:
- Resume library deletion warns it affects all CVs [confirmation](../frontend/src/app/resume/library.tsx:117), and service deletes every corresponding resume item [backend](../backend/src/modules/resume/index.ts:213). Minor feedback deletion has no confirmation or undo [handler](../frontend/src/app/minor/sprints/[id]/use-sprint-data.ts:73). Invoice uses generic permanent-delete confirmation [handler](../frontend/src/app/cashflow/invoices/[id]/page.tsx:59).
- A recommended: archive library/feedback records, undo toast and recoverable trash; show affected CV names/count before deleting shared entries. For sent invoices preserve history and offer clear void/correct workflow (requirements must be agreed before implementation). B: retain hard delete with explicit impact dialog and version snapshots; less schema work but slower and less forgiving.
- Acceptance: accidental delete recoverable; restore recovers links/order/overrides; deletion consequence clear before commit; per-user authorization applies to trash too.

title: Add focused Resume output modes rather than a broad career suite
body:
- Current editor offers font/layout/item choices and PDF export [editor](../frontend/src/app/resume/[id]/client.tsx:55), with real PDF preview [preview](../frontend/src/components/resume-pdf-preview.tsx:42). Reusable library and per-CV description override already solve tailoring well [override](../frontend/src/app/resume/[id]/client.tsx:178).
- A recommended: add simple single-column template, output-language choice, export preflight (page count, overflow, text reading order) and structured JSON backup. B: Word export/import if applications frequently require editable documents; higher maintenance. C: retain present scope, add only quality checks. Do not copy AI assistant/job tracker features merely because competitors offer them.
- Acceptance: same data works in both layouts; selected language controls section/date labels; exported text order is checked using sample CV; long content fits readable pages; backup roundtrips without loss. No ATS defect was demonstrated; two-column PDFs require actual extraction testing before claiming one.

title: Speed recipe capture only after atomic saves
body: Recipe form is manual entry [form:38–165](../../frontend/src/components/recipe-form.tsx#L38); Paprika documents web import and combining grocery ingredients [official](https://www.paprikaapp.com/). Option A/recommended first: paste/import preview with editable ingredients and source URL. Option B: weekly meal plan and grocery aggregation if recurring planning is a real user need; adds substantial complexity (units, duplicates, pantry). Acceptance: import is reviewable before saving, errors never create partial recipes, unsupported units remain explicit. Dependency D02. Avoid auto-saving scraped content or building a social recipe platform.

title: Decide whether Wines is a tasting notebook or cellar inventory
body: Current schema has brand/type/grape/vintage/region/purchase location/rating/notes/photo but no bottle quantity, storage location, consumption events or tasting history [schema:5–18](../../backend/src/db/schema/wines.ts#L5). CellarTracker documents bottle-level tracking, purchases, consumption and drinking windows [official tracking guide](https://support.cellartracker.com/article/32-what-can-be-tracked), [ready-to-drink report](https://support.cellartracker.com/article/28-ready-to-drink-report), checked 2026-10-19. Option A/recommended unless real cellar need: lightweight tasting notebook with repeat tasting entries and 'buy again'. Option B: quantity + consume/undo + location, transaction-backed stock history; optional user-entered drinking window later. Acceptance: drinking a bottle preserves tasting history, stock never negative, undo restores count. Avoid AI sommelier/social marketplace without demonstrated value. Quick win independently: filtered empty states incorrectly say recipes/status and invite 'first wine' even when filter merely has no results; show wines/type and Clear filters [wine page:136–145](../../frontend/src/app/recipes/wines/page.tsx#L136).
